An '''interface pad''' was a decryption [[Computer/Legends|computer]]. It resembled a large [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] with extra keys and input jacks. [[Loh'khar]] the Finder procured one for [[Thella]] to decrypt a stolen [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[processor]].
